description: This file implements drag-and-drop functionality for a lazy list in a Jetpack Compose UI, including state management, gesture detection, and item animation.

classes.name: DragDropState
classes.description: Manages the state and behavior for drag-and-drop operations within a lazy list, including tracking item positions, handling drag gestures, and coordinating animations.

methods.name: rememberDragDropState
methods.description: Creates and remembers a DragDropState instance, setting up automatic scrolling during drag operations.

methods.name: DragDropState.onDragStart
methods.description: Handles the initiation of a drag gesture, determining which item is being dragged based on the touch offset.

methods.name: DragDropState.onDrag
methods.description: Updates the position of the dragged item, detects target items for potential reordering, and manages overscroll behavior.

methods.name: DragDropState.onDragEnd
methods.description: Finalizes the drag operation, calling the onEnd callback if the item was moved to a different position.

methods.name: DragDropState.onDragInterrupted
methods.description: Handles cancellation or interruption of a drag, resetting state and animating the item back to its original position.
